_about: Queue settings for pull_queues.py --state MD. name is the State/Province value in the GEM export; markets are the queues read (all of Maryland is in PJM: BGE, Pepco, Delmarva, Potomac Edison, SMECO); owner and shared_owner are only used for MISO, which does not reach Maryland, so both are empty; pjm_states is the PJM State values kept; known is hand-checked patterns, GEM plant id to regexes that name that plant in a point of interconnection, project name or developer, empty until the first Maryland queue run is checked. Every match still says check.
name: Maryland
